content:
Giulia Taglialatela was born in Naples into a family of intellectuals and art collectors. She spent her formative years in America traveling extensively and developing a vibrant cultural baggage. A constant pursuit of beauty and strong aesthetic sense brought her to in Milan, first to study communication and journalism, then followed by work in fashion, luxury and design - all of which today she seamlessly blends in her conception of impactful imagery.
For over ten years Giulia Taglialatela has focused on set design, interior design, creative direction and consultancy, a variety of roles that enable her to fully express her multi-faceted persona. Through her continuous visual research and depth of content, emerge lasting and emotional contemporary sceneries that are distinguished by a harmonious play of objects in space yet marked by an eclectic spin.
